resume.headline: Senior Videographer & Video Producer
resume.summary: Senior videographer with seven-plus years shooting, lighting, and editing brand films, documentaries, interviews, and social video. Delivered 200+ videos at Grand Canyon Education that reached millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels, including an alumni campaign that ran during NCAA basketball broadcasts. Commands crews of 5 to 20, owns the full pipeline from storyboard to final color grade, and delivers 98% of projects on time.

jobs.title: Owner / Producer
bullets: Crafted cinematic corporate documentaries and interviews, and increased brand presence for construction companies by turning construction into cinema.
Commanded crews of 5 to 20 and partnered with CEOs and executives, delivering 98% of projects on time and 92% within budget.
Shot on Sony FX cameras, sculpted light with Aputure, and color graded Sony S-Log3 in DaVinci Resolve; built motion graphics in After Effects.
Reached over a million people on YouTube teaching cutting-edge post-production techniques.

jobs.title: Media Specialist
bullets: Created and led a video initiative that raised click-through rates for running ads by over 200%.
Created and led a social media content initiative that earned more than 20x the engagement of standard content.
Built AI content workflows with Claude that cut production times in half while keeping stories authentic and real.
Grew the video library 7x with key stakeholders and planned the role of video and photography in enrollment with executives.

jobs.title: Video Producer (Part Time)
bullets: Deployed RED and Canon cameras daily to capture high-end political video during a critical stretch of the session.
Rebuilt color grading workflows to run 3x faster in DaVinci Resolve with Canon Log-3 and RED Wide Gamut footage.
Documented prominent figures including Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and the AZ Speaker of the House.

jobs.title: Videographer
bullets: Delivered 200+ videos over two years that reached millions on TV, paid social, and organic channels.
Catalyzed an alumni campaign shown during NCAA basketball games, leading to a noticeable increase in engagement.
Directed cinematography for higher-end brand shoots every quarter inside a 15-person media team.
Maximized over $1 million of in-house gear, including Sony FX3 and FX6 systems, Aputure lighting, and DJI Inspire 2 drones.

jobs.title: Photography Teacher
bullets: Mentored 90+ students a year, stewarded a $30k equipment inventory, and grew the program's social media to lift enrollment 20%.

skills: Editing (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro)
Color Grading (S-Log3, Canon Log-3, RED Wide Gamut)
AI Video (Runway, Kling, Google Veo, Midjourney, ElevenLabs)
